title: ISSUE-104 · Checkout total has the wrong type
report: The invoicing service expects totalAfterTax to return integer cents. A refactor introduced a TypeScript type error. Keep the existing input validation and rounded cents calculation. Do not change the public function signature.

title: ISSUE-117 · Critical incidents wait behind routine tickets
report: The dispatcher selects older normal-priority work before newer critical incidents. Priority order must be critical, high, normal. Break ties using the earliest createdAt. Do not mutate the input array. Return null for an empty queue.

title: ISSUE-126 · Request logs expose authentication headers
report: The structured logger leaks credentials when header names are capitalised or use alternative names. Redact Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie, X-API-Key, and Proxy-Authorization, regardless of case. Keep other headers unchanged, and do not mutate caller input.
